title: The Hawk's Stoop Wind Canon
summary: A canon of diving wind arts that gather height and speed and then fall on a foe like a stooping hawk.

title: Twin-Court Compendium of Air
summary: A compendium of mirrored wind arts in which one current guards while its twin strikes and both end in a swallowing vortex.

title: The Azure Gale Canon
summary: A canon of high clear-sky wind arts that thin the air and blur the student until an enemy cannot fix their place.

title: Compendium of the Basin Winds
summary: A compendium of heavy sinking winds that pool and pin a foe and then break loose in a single flashing rush.

title: The Paired Track Storm Manual
summary: A manual of storms run on two offset tracks that overlap and chain until their merged blow falls as one cyclone.

title: The Hawk and Azure Breath Canon
summary: A canon of the gentler breath of the sky that clears taint and lends breath to the failing and mends hurts in the end.

title: The Wind-Sworn Canon
summary: A canon of the wind-sworn whose vow binds their qi to the wind and whose blows fall as an oath fulfilled.

title: Manual of the Taken Bearing
summary: A manual of bearings taken against headwind and tailwind and crosswind and of the straight rush that follows them.

title: The Open Rim Oath Canon
summary: A canon of the oath spoken at the open rim of the plateau and of the plunging wind that enforces it.

title: Treatise of the Unbound Air
summary: A treatise on air that holds to no mooring and no wall and that wanders as a cyclone through whatever it meets.

title: The Canon of the Last Exhale
summary: A canon of the breath at its edge that scours the lungs and lends breath to the dying and recalls it within a short window.

title: The Wall-Less Gale Handbook
summary: A handbook of the wind that fences nothing and is fenced by nothing and so rolls across the whole field at once.
